tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the site shell and every light section.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: The alternate light band (the trial section) and the ground under PriceCard.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on paper (13.7:1), paper-deep (12.3:1) and white (14.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on paper (5.9:1), paper-deep (5.3:1) and white (6.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows, section rules and input borders on paper. Decorative, not a contrast carrier (1.6:1).

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, eyebrows, list numbers, icons, link hover. As text on paper (5.4:1) or white (5.8:1).

tokens.name: terracotta-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; white text on it reads 7.2:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Soft highlight: the pending-review pulse on OrderCard's current checklist row.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Dark bands (dark-section), the notice bar and OrderCard's top strip. White text on it reads 14.6:1.

tokens.name: dark-soft
tokens.usage: A raised dark surface in the palette; no current component uses it.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card surfaces (OrderCard, FormCard, PriceCard) and text on dark (14.6:1) and on terracotta (5.8:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Alias of paper under the name the stylesheet's base layer reads.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Alias of ink under the name the stylesheet's base layer reads.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias of terracotta for code that reads --primary.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Alias of white: text on a primary (terracotta) fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Alias of line: the default border color.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Alias of terracotta for focus rings.

tokens.name: dark-copy
tokens.usage: Paragraphs and eyebrows inside dark-section (8.4:1 on dark). Kept from the site as is: the FormCard note inside a dark section inherits it and reads only 1.7:1 on the white card.

tokens.name: warm-on-dark
tokens.usage: Icons and column headings on dark grounds: FeatureGrid, PromiseList, the footer's link titles (6.6:1 on dark).

tokens.name: dark-rule
tokens.usage: Rules and borders inside dark sections: FeatureGrid columns, ControlPanel rows and border.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: ControlPanel's surface; white text on it reads 12.6:1.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: SiteFooter's ground, darker than dark.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Small capital labels on white cards (OrderCard's label, PriceCard's label). Kept from the site: 4.4:1 on white, just under 4.5:1 at its 10px size.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Completed checklist rows on OrderCard and FormCard's success check. Kept from the site: 3.9:1 on the checklist's #f2f0e9 ground.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: The pending badge's fill on OrderCard.

tokens.name: pending-ink
tokens.usage: The pending badge's text on pending-bg. Kept from the site: 4.4:1 at 9px.

tokens.name: led
tokens.usage: The live status light on ControlPanel (5.9:1 on panel).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces at 500, tracked tight. Heading sizes scale with the viewport; the values are the desktop maximum.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Recover the phone orders your restaurant misses during the rush.
styles.usage: The page title, once per page (Heading level 1). clamp(52px, 6.5vw, 93px); 51 to 73px on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles (Heading, the default level). clamp(42px, 5vw, 69px).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and column titles (Heading level 3); 24px in WorkflowSteps, FeatureGrid and Timeline.

styles.name: large-copy
styles.sample: Calls go unanswered. Staff put callers on hold.
styles.usage: The serif lead paragraph that opens a section (Text variant lead). Class large-copy.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Manrope for everything that is read rather than scanned.

styles.name: hero-lede
styles.sample: Kadmivo answers routine restaurant calls, checks each order against the menu you approve.
styles.usage: The hero's introduction (Text variant lede). Class hero-lede.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Those missed calls become missed orders and frustrated customers.
styles.usage: Paragraphs (Text). ink-soft on light grounds, dark-copy in dark sections.

styles.name: hero-emphasis
styles.sample: Your team checks the order before it reaches the POS or kitchen.
styles.usage: One short bold line after the lede (Text variant emphasis), in ink.

styles.name: detail
styles.sample: Give routine callers a path during the hours you choose.
styles.usage: The line of detail in list rows and columns: NumberedList, WorkflowSteps, FeatureGrid, Timeline.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Small, heavy and spaced; uppercase is set by the style, not typed.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button, the header's call to action and TextLink labels, sentence case.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Capital labels on cards (OrderCard, PriceCard), typed in capitals.

styles.name: notice
styles.usage: The notice bar above the header, uppercase.

spacing.note: The stylesheet sets spacing per component; these are the page-level measures it repeats.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop (inline style on the <section>).

tokens.name: section-y-phone
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section at 680px and narrower.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of section-grid and of RuleCallout, FeatureGrid and Timeline (92vw below that).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: SiteHeader's height on desktop (66px on phones).

radius.note: Square corners everywhere; round only for dots.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Every surface: buttons, cards, inputs, badges, panels.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, the live status light and the hero ring.

shadow.note: One offset shadow, for the paper ticket; everything else is flat and ruled.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: OrderCard's hard offset shadow at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket-hover
tokens.usage: OrderCard's shadow on hover, as it lifts.

tokens.name: shadow-led
tokens.usage: The halo around ControlPanel's status light.
